Cauldrons
Vanilla water, lava, and powder-snow cauldron transitions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets: block-state changes, protection, sound, and stat/criterion accounting.

A fluid that a vanilla cauldron holds as one bucket-volume.
ClientModelTypes
Ids of the item-definition types Some Buckets adds: the FluidBucketModel item model, the JunkContentsRenderer special renderer, and the MobEggColors.Tint tint source.

Loader-resolved rendering facts for a stored fluid.

Resolves a stored fluid's rendering facts through the loader's client fluid API.

Defines the ordered contents of the Some Buckets creative tab.
DiagnosticReport
Shared formatting, classification vocabulary, and file output for the /sb diagnostic commands.
DiagnosticReport.Row
One report entry.
DiagnosticReport.Status
Classification of one report entry, most benign first.
Dispensers
Dispenser behavior for all six Some Buckets items.
EggDiagnostics
/sb eggs: walks every registered entity type and records the spawn-egg colors the Mob Bucket tints its overlays with, flagging capturable types that have no egg, eggs whose item definition supplies no colors, and eggs whose two colors give no usable tint.
FluidBucketItem
Base of the mod's single-fluid-container buckets (Big, Huge, and Source Bucket): the fluid container rules every loader's fluid storage and the shared fluid logic apply, content naming, the crafting remainder contract, lava fuel, cow milking, milk drinking, and the gesture helpers both item classes share.
FluidBucketModel
Item model for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets, registered as somebuckets:fluid_bucket.
FluidBucketModel.Look
The fluid layer's still sprite, stack-aware ARGB tint, and emissiveness.
FluidBucketModel.Unbaked
Item-definition form: {"type": "somebuckets:fluid_bucket", "model": <vessel model>}.
FluidDiagnostics
/sb fluids: walks every registered source fluid and mirrors the Big and Source Bucket bar-color path so a modpack's fluids can be checked for ones that render as the fallback color or collapse to near-black.
FluidDiagnostics.FluidColorSample
One fluid's client color breakdown.
FluidMaskGeometry
Loads the bucket content mask as generated-item surface geometry and packs mask-shaped quads in vanilla's block vertex format.
FluidMaskGeometry.Face
One outward-facing mask quad.
FluidMaskGeometry.Vertex
One vertex with normalized item-model coordinates.
FluidTransactions
Loader-neutral fluid transactions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets after an item or dispenser selects a gesture, plus vanilla-contract world pickup and fixed-water placement.
HeldTransfers
Held-hand bucket operations: transfer between one of this mod's fluid buckets and whatever the other hand holds, milk handling, and settling the hand afterward.
JBItem
FIFO storage for item-stack entries and the shared interaction base for Junk and Trash Buckets.
JunkContentsRenderer
Special item renderer for the Junk Bucket's stored stacks, registered as somebuckets:junk_contents.
JunkContentsRenderer.Frame
A bucket's stored stacks and the placements drawn for them, oldest entry in front.
JunkContentsRenderer.Unbaked
Item-definition form: {"type": "somebuckets:junk_contents", "texture": <vessel sprite for the cover>}.
LegacyBucketMigration
Converts recognized 1.20.1 bucket fields in minecraft:custom_data into registered data components.
MBItem
FIFO storage for full mob snapshots, limited to one exact entity type per bucket.
MobEggColors
The sole source of Mob Bucket overlay colors.
MobEggColors.Tint
Mob Bucket overlay tint, registered as somebuckets:mob_egg: {"type": "somebuckets:mob_egg", "index": 0|1} selects the primary or secondary color of the captured type.

Captured entity type and FIFO entity snapshots.

Sink for ModDataComponentTypes.forEach(com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.register.ModDataComponentTypes.Registrar); a loader adapts its own registry call to this shape.
ProtectionContext
Identity attached to an authorized mutation.
Protections
The permission checks vanilla applies before a bucket changes the world, applied to the context's actor.

SomeBucketItem
Base of every Some Buckets item.
SomeBuckets
